page_title: MAL 2-1 RAY | Mallorca v Rayo Vallecano 11/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's it for today, Jose Luis Munuera Montero has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+8' It's a throw-in for Rayo Vallecano.
90+5' Abdon Prats (Mallorca) is punished with the yellow card.
90+1' 2 - 1 Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) gets on the end of the corner and fires the ball inside the right post.
90+1' The ball goes out of play. Mallorca are awarded a corner kick.
90+1' The resulting set piece from Mallorca is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Stole Dimitrievski, who smothers the ball.
89' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) pounces on a cross into the middle of the box, but plants his header well wide of the right post.
87' Jaime Ramos is forced to make a change. Pep Chavarria is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano).
87' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
85' Abdon Prats (Mallorca) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
84' Javier Aguirre decides to make a substitution. Jaume Costa will be replaced by Toni Lato (Mallorca).
83' Abdon Prats (Mallorca) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
82' The game is interrupted now, Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
80' Abdon Prats (Mallorca) spanks one well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
79' Javier Aguirre has decided to substitute Antonio Sanchez and he is replaced by Samu Costa (Mallorca).
79' Substitution. Nemanja Radonjic (Mallorca) replaces Omar Mascarell.
79' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) takes a rebound on the edge of the box and slams the ball well wide of the right post.
77' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the crossbar, but Stole Dimitrievski easily deals with the threat.

76' 1 - 1 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 1:1.
74' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar.
71' Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) makes a strong challenge and Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows for a foul.
70' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball miles wide of the right post. Nice run, but poor finish!
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) is coming onto the pitch as Kike Perez cannot continue after picking up an injury.
68' Jaime Ramos prepares a substitution. Alfonso Espino is replaced by Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano).
68' Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows for a foul.
65' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Mallorca comes to nothing.
63' Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
62' Substitution. Sergi Darder did his best and is replaced by Manu Morlanes (Mallorca).
62' Jaime Ramos has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) replacing Pathe Ciss.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) comes onto the pitch for Sergio Camello.
61' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
59' Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.

56' What a poor attempt! Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes yards wide of the left post.
55' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
55' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Rayo Vallecano force a corner. They send men into the box.

54' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Stole Dimitrievski tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
53' Abdon Prats (Mallorca) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
52' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle for an infringement.
51' One of the players from Mallorca times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
48' 1 - 0 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 1:0.
48' The attendance for today's match is 16735.
47' Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) makes a rough challenge and Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle for a foul.
46' It's time for a substitution. Abdon Prats (Mallorca) comes on in place of Nacho Vidal.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The match has reached half-time.
43' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Predrag Rajkovic.
42' Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Predrag Rajkovic stops the ball from hitting the bottom left corner.
41' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Jose Luis Munuera Montero didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
39' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
39' The foul by Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jose Luis Munuera Montero.
38' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
34' The resulting corner from Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
34' Nacho Vidal (Mallorca) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Mallorca force their opponents to concede a corner.
32' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
31' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat.
28' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) heads the ball towards goal, but the goalkeeper denies his effort by making an easy save.
28' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
27' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
25' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) commits a foul and Jose Luis Munuera Montero immediately signals a free kick.
24' Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) serves up a nice cross, but Stole Dimitrievski punches the ball away.
22' Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
21' A pass by Nacho Vidal (Mallorca) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
19' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Rayo Vallecano.
17' The ball is behind the touchline and Mallorca will take a throw-in.
13' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
13' Rayo Vallecano are awarded a free kick from long range.
12' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero signals.
11' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) latches on to a loose ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot on goal, but the effort lacks accuracy and flies well wide of the left post.
11' Mallorca can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
9' The ball is cleared after Nacho Vidal (Mallorca) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
7' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
6' Jaume Costa (Mallorca) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
6' One of the Mallorca players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
5' The ball has crossed the sideline. Rayo Vallecano are taking a throw-in.
2' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Predrag Rajkovic makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
2' Rayo Vallecano are awarded a mid-range free kick.
1' Matija Nastasic (Mallorca) gets booked for the first time in this match.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Mallorca will take the kick-off.
Jose Luis Munuera Montero is the one to supervise the game today.
